predict.question: You start a project with one unit of progress and add exactly one unit per round, with no proportional growth. After eight rounds, how many units do you have?

exploreHint: Compare both named cases; keep each result for the reveal.
bookIdea: Grit emphasizes sustained effort toward long-term goals.
modelBoundary: Four rounds finish at {A}; eight at {B}. Extra rounds add fixed units; nothing in this recurrence measures passion or grit.
doesItHoldUp: Does it hold up? Real progress can stall or reverse, and effort’s productivity is not fixed.
